subject: INITIATE statement
notes: Rule: 'An INITIATE statement that specifies more than one report-name-1 shall not be specified in an exception checking PERFORM statement.' (cite.py --check 14.9.21.3 -> OK §14.9.21.3 3)). CODE: over region B (imperative-statement-1 + every WHEN / WHEN OTHER / WHEN COMMON body + FINALLY) every descendant InitiateStatementContext with reportName().Length > 1 -> error COBOL1605. PROBES s1-s6 (2023): multi-name INITIATE in imperative-statement-1 (s1), a WHEN body (s2), FINALLY (s3), nested inside IF + inline PERFORM (s4), WHEN OTHER / WHEN COMMON (s6) -> COBOL1605 each; two single-name INITIATEs (s5) and a multi-name INITIATE AFTER END-PERFORM (s2, s6) accepted and run. The rule counts operands, which is what the check counts.
